logline: 아우와 아내를 함께 아끼던 뱃사람이, 어느 날 닫힌 방문 앞에 선다.
destination: 닫힌 안방 문 — 그가 열게 되는 자리
protagonist: 영유 바닷가에서 배를 부리는 서른 살 사내
setting: 20세기 초 평안도 바닷가 어촌, 배와 초가와 장터
anchor: a weathered fisherman in a coarse hemp jacket and headband, thick shoulders, sun-darkened face
palette: sea grey-green, salt-bleached wood, low amber lamplight, cold sky

beats.beat: 뱃사람이 아우와 함께 그물을 걷어 올린다.
beats.visual: two men hauling a dripping net over the side of a wooden boat, open grey sea around them
beats.motion: the net rises streaming water, the boat rocks, gulls cut across

beats.visual: a woman setting a low meal table before a younger man in a thatched room, older man in the doorway
beats.motion: steam lifts off the bowls, she laughs, the doorway figure goes still

beats.beat: 그는 두 사람의 웃음소리에 노를 멈춘다.
beats.visual: a fisherman motionless at the oars of a moored boat, head turned toward a lit house on the shore
beats.motion: the oar drips, water laps the hull, his head stays turned

beats.beat: 장터에서 그는 아내에게 줄 거울을 산다.
beats.visual: a fisherman holding a small round hand mirror at a crowded market stall, coins in his other palm
beats.motion: the mirror catches light and flashes, the crowd jostles, his thumb rubs the rim

beats.beat: 집에 돌아오니 안방 문이 닫혀 있다.
beats.visual: a fisherman standing in a courtyard facing a closed paper door with lamplight behind it
beats.motion: lamplight flickers behind the paper, his hand rises, wind stirs the yard

beats.beat: 문을 열자 두 사람이 옷매무새를 고친다.
beats.visual: a woman and a younger man straightening their clothes inside a small room, a man frozen in the doorway
beats.motion: their hands move quickly to their collars, the door swings wide, lamp gutters

beats.beat: 그가 본 것은 정말 그가 생각한 것일까?
beats.visual: a fisherman standing alone on a night shore looking back at a small lit house, boat dark beside him
beats.motion: waves push at the hull, his fists open and close, the house light dims

beats.beat: 빈 배 한 척이 달빛 바다에 떠 있다.
beats.visual: an empty wooden boat drifting on a moonlit sea, oars shipped, shoreline dark and far away
beats.motion: the boat rocks on the swell, moonlight breaks on the water, a rope trails

withheld: 그가 아내와 아우를 내쫓은 뒤 아내가 돌아오지 못하게 되는 결말
